zh-CN.description: oberth 是面向 Git worktree 的本地服务引擎：声明一份清单，就能回答该跑什么、是不是真在跑、没跑是为什么。人和 coding agent 读同一份事实。
zh-CN.hero_lede: 声明一份清单，回答该跑什么、是不是真在跑、没跑是为什么。人和 coding agent 读同一份事实。
zh-CN.commands_title: 一条命令，回答三个问题。
zh-CN.commands_intro: 该跑什么、是不是真在跑、没跑是为什么。命令行把同一份契约交给人和 agent：人读文本，agent 读 --json。
zh-CN.command_empty: 没有匹配的命令。清空输入查看全部。
zh-CN.cmd_status_desc: 现在是什么状态：声明、运行、端口和最近一次退出。
zh-CN.cmd_up_desc: 按 depends_on 顺序启动服务，并等待实际就绪。
zh-CN.cmd_logs_desc: 回到失败现场，读服务自己的输出，不重新拼一条系统命令。
zh-CN.cmd_down_desc: 只停这个 worktree 的项目服务，不动另一个 checkout。
zh-CN.cmd_workplace_desc: 记录做过的命令与任务，留在 worktree 上，下一轮还能接手。
zh-CN.cmd_doctor_desc: 检查环境、清单与运行条件，不把未知当成成功。
zh-CN.chain_title: 你确认清单，引擎回答事实。
zh-CN.chain_intro: 清单由人确认，模型只能起草。oberth.yaml 说该跑什么，status --json 说现在怎样；两者之间没有第二份状态。
zh-CN.chain_code_comment: # 人确认的清单，不从运行中的进程猜
zh-CN.steps_title: 从清单到事实，只有一条链。
zh-CN.steps_intro: 运行归属跟着起它的 worktree。停一个项目，不动另一个 checkout；machine: 依赖只读，起停都不碰。
zh-CN.step_3: 引擎观察进程、端口与退出。
zh-CN.step_4: 人和 agent 读同一份事实。
zh-CN.products_intro: 它们只通过 CLI 与 --json 契约相连。客户端和 skill 都不保存第二份运行状态。
zh-CN.product_engine_meta: 本仓库 · CLI 压缩包
zh-CN.product_engine_desc: oberth：声明、观察、起停一个 worktree 的服务。
zh-CN.product_client_desc: 原生界面：服务、只读 Git 与终端/agent 会话，呈现同一份事实。
zh-CN.product_skill_desc: 教 agent 读懂事实、把服务跑起来、留下并取回工作记录。
zh-CN.install_intro: 发布包只包含引擎与 adapter：macOS、Linux、Windows 的 amd64/arm64 压缩包，附 SHA256SUMS 与运行时许可。
zh-CN.install_release_body: 脚本解析最新发布，按平台下载并核对 SHA256，装到 ~/.local/bin；固定版本加 --version。
zh-CN.install_release_windows: Windows 用 PowerShell：irm .../install.ps1 | iex。完整服务场景在 macOS/Linux 验证；Windows 是独立原生构建与冒烟，不等于完整的生命周期支持。
zh-CN.install_note: 构建不会安装软件或启动日常服务。mage install 会写入安装目录并修改 PATH。
zh-CN.faq_a1: 界面是独立的 macOS 客户端，不在这个仓库，也不随引擎发布。
zh-CN.faq_q2: 会接管整台机器的端口吗？
zh-CN.faq_a2: 不会。它只回答当前 worktree 声明的服务；machine: 依赖只读，起停不碰它们。
zh-CN.faq_a3: 产品的 Git 操作只读。清单由人确认，agent 可以起草，但不能代替你采纳。
zh-CN.faq_q4: 没有端口就是没在运行吗？
zh-CN.faq_a4: 不是。无端口 worker 通过运行记录观察；进程、监听和健康是分开的事实。
zh-CN.faq_a5: 有原生构建、冒烟和部分事实/持久化检查；完整服务场景只在 macOS/Linux 验证。
zh-CN.faq_q6: 需要模型账号或云端吗？
zh-CN.faq_a6: 不需要。引擎本地运行，不内置模型推理，也没有云端同步。
zh-CN.cta_title: 给下一份代码，一个泊位。
zh-CN.cta_body: 引擎、客户端与 skill 各自发版，共用同一条事实链。
zh-CN.footer_line: 本地优先，边界清楚。让代码各自成泊。

en.page_title: option-berth · the service engine for worktrees
en.description: oberth is a local service engine for Git worktrees. Declare one manifest and it answers what should run, whether it really is, and why not — the same facts for people and coding agents.
en.hero_lede: Declare one manifest and it answers what should run, whether it really is, and why not. People and coding agents read the same facts.
en.commands_intro: What should run, whether it really is, and why not. The command line gives people and agents the same contract: people read text, agents read --json.
en.command_empty: No matching command. Clear the field to see them all.
en.cmd_status_desc: What is true now: declaration, runtime, ports and the last exit.
en.cmd_up_desc: Start services in depends_on order and wait for real readiness.
en.cmd_logs_desc: Return to the failure scene and read the service's own output.
en.cmd_down_desc: Stop only this worktree's services, without touching another checkout.
en.cmd_workplace_desc: Keep the commands and tasks run here on the worktree for the next session.
en.cmd_doctor_desc: Check the environment, manifest and run conditions without calling unknown a success.
en.chain_title: You confirm the manifest. The engine answers with facts.
en.chain_intro: A person confirms the manifest; a model may only draft it. oberth.yaml says what should run, status --json says what is true now, and no second state sits between them.
en.chain_code_comment: # Human-confirmed; not inferred from a process
en.steps_title: From manifest to facts, there is one chain.
en.steps_intro: Ownership follows the worktree that started a run. Stopping one project leaves another checkout alone, and machine: dependencies stay read-only.
en.step_2: oberth starts services in dependency order.
en.step_3: The engine observes processes, ports and exits.
en.step_4: People and agents read the same facts.
en.products_intro: They meet only at the CLI and its --json contract. Neither the client nor the skill keeps a second copy of runtime state.
en.product_engine_desc: oberth: declare, observe, start and stop one worktree's services.
en.product_client_desc: A native surface for services, read-only Git and terminal/agent sessions over the same facts.
en.product_skill_desc: Teaches an agent to read the facts, run the services, and leave work behind for the next session.
en.install_intro: Release archives contain only the engine and adapter: amd64/arm64 archives for macOS, Linux and Windows, with SHA256SUMS and runtime notices.
en.install_release_body: The script resolves the latest release, downloads the archive for this platform, verifies SHA256, and installs into ~/.local/bin; pin a version with --version.
en.install_release_windows: On Windows use PowerShell: irm .../install.ps1 | iex. Full service scenarios are verified on macOS/Linux; Windows has native build and smoke checks, not full lifecycle coverage.
en.install_note: Building installs nothing and starts no daily service. mage install writes to the install directory and changes PATH.
en.faq_q1: Does it have a graphical interface?
en.faq_a1: The interface is the separate macOS client. It is not in this repository and does not ship with the engine.
en.faq_q2: Does it take over every port on the machine?
en.faq_a2: No. It answers only for the current worktree's declared services; machine: dependencies stay read-only.
en.faq_q3: Does it write to my Git repository?
en.faq_a3: Product Git actions are read-only. A person confirms the manifest; an agent may draft it but cannot adopt it for you.
en.faq_q4: Does no port mean it is not running?
en.faq_a4: No. A portless worker is observed through its run record; process, listener and health are separate facts.
en.faq_a5: There are native builds, smoke tests and some fact/persistence checks. Full service scenarios are verified only on macOS/Linux.
en.faq_q6: Does it need a model account or the cloud?
en.faq_a6: No. The engine runs locally, contains no model inference and has no cloud sync.
en.cta_title: A berth for your next checkout.
en.cta_body: The engine, client and skill release on their own schedules and share one chain of facts.
en.footer_line: Local first. Clear boundaries. A place for every worktree.
